finalText:
**Redis died at `02:14:07` and never came back.** That took the whole service down 18 minutes later.

The chain, in order:

1. `02:14:07` — `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`, cache falls back to direct store reads.
2. Cache miss storm hits the store. 173 `TimeoutError` at 5000ms across all four processes.
3. Request queue climbs steadily, 52 up to 568 against a max of 500.
4. `02:31:44` — `worker-2` dies with `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`, exit code 134.
5. `02:31:52` — `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`.

All 13 redis reconnect attempts failed with the same `ECONNREFUSED`. Redis was down the whole time, not flapping. See [app.log:182](logs/app.log:182).

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` went away. The app had no cache-loss backpressure, so one Redis outage was enough to kill it.
